recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless PA later changes the Encounter.admission origin/destination target resource set.
issue_request: FHIR-15021 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by PA. It requested that Encounter.hospitalization.origin and, per comments/resolution, Encounter.hospitalization.destination use Reference(Organization|Location) because the facility may be known only as an Organization rather than a Location.
initial_application: The request was applied in the historical Encounter spreadsheet: b60b1f71994c66dccd2ef3964fd52a956acaa535 changed Encounter.hospitalization.origin to Reference(Location|Organization) and location/organization wording, and d81b5a8c41222f15a1fb9151aba3d8a8212d5dc7 corrected Encounter.hospitalization.destination as part of FHIR-15021.
additional_context: FHIR-32390 later renamed Encounter.hospitalization to Encounter.admission for R5. Current fhir.ini keeps maps from Encounter.hospitalization.origin and .destination to Encounter.admission.origin and .destination, and Encounter remains an active approved resource. A PA Zulip discussion supports the rationale and vote; Confluence searches found no FHIR-15021 reference or conflicting exact-key hit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml already gives Encounter.admission.origin and Encounter.admission.destination Location and Organization targetProfiles, preserving the FHIR-15021 semantics under the later rename.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Encounter.hospitalization to Encounter.admission, explaining the current source element names while preserving the FHIR-15021 target-profile change.
